headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of July 1, 2026, the portfolio set has delivered an average return of 15.90%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 10.06%. This results in an average alpha of 5.84%, indicating that the portfolios are not only rising in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has achieved a remarkable return of 44.63%, contributing a dollar change of $446.25. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100', has returned 6.53%, highlighting the variability in performance across the portfolio set. This outperformance relative to SPY is particularly notable during periods of market uncertainty, reinforcing the strength of the portfolio's positioning. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
